Leon fights hordes of enemies infected by a mind-controlling parasite and reunites with the female spy and mercenary Ada Wong. Jaguar:club-drive.d: Club Drive is a 1994 racing simulation video game developed and published by Atari Corporation for the Atari Jaguar. The game allows exploration of various themed arenas, with each mode featuring its own set of rules and objectives for competitive play. Club Drive was conceived by lead programmer Todd Powers and produced by James "Purple" Hampton.

iOS:heroes-of-might-and-magic-3.d: Heroes of Might and Magic III: The Restoration of Erathia (commonly referred to as Heroes of Might and Magic 3, or Heroes 3, or abbreviated HoMM 3) is a turn-based strategy game, developed by Jon Van Caneghem through New World Computing and originally released for Microsoft Windows by The 3DO Company in 1999. As the third installment of the Heroes of Might and Magic series, the game was released to universal acclaim and commercial success, becoming a defining classic of the turn-based strategy genre. Android:automatoys.d: Automatoys is a 2022 puzzle game developed by Idle Friday. In it, the player guides a ball through a series of complex three-dimensional machines. The game was the first independent release of lead developer Steffan Glynn, a former member of State of Play Games. Upon release, Automatoys received mixed reviews, with praise for its level design and gameplay and criticism for its short length.

Arcade:mobile-suit-gundam.d: The popularity of the Japanese anime metaseries Gundam since its release in 1979 has resulted in a spread of merchandise across various forms, with video games among them. This is a list of video games that are set in the franchise's various timelines, and are segregated by the console systems they were released for. There are around 250 games, and by March 2004, the series had sold over 20 million units. For the grid-based tactics games, see the SD Gundam G Generation games list.
